youtube.title: Which country hosted the first Winter Olympics? Not who you think ⛸️
youtube.description:
The ski-resort country, the skiing superpower, or the third one? The first Winter Olympics were held in a small mountain town a century ago and were not even called the Olympics at the time; the host nation went home without a single gold, and the name was awarded two years after the Games ended.
Which did you pick?

facebook.text:
Which country hosted the first Winter Olympics — Switzerland, Norway or France?
They were held in a small mountain town a century ago and were not even called the Olympics at the time; the host nation went home without a single gold, and the name was awarded two years after the Games ended. Pick your flag before the medal bars go up.
